title: An Eight-Week Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of VSJ-110 Compared to Placebo in the Treatment of Dry Eye
official: An Eight-Week, Double-Masked, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled, Phase 2, Evaluation of the Safety and Efficacy of VSJ-110 Ophthalmic Solution in the Treatment of Dry Eye
summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the safety and efficacy of VSJ-110 compared to placebo in the treatment of dry eye.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Be at least 18 years of age of either gender and any race.
* Provide written informed consent and sign the HIPAA form.
* Be willing and able to follow all instructions and attend all study visits.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Use of any of the disallowed medications during the washout and study period.
